Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
v1.0.0.72 Stable update

Party Cooldowns
- Added clipboard export and import for all jobs or a single job.
- Shared setups include selected abilities, custom rows, the active side, and both sides' position, icon size, and spacing. Widget visibility and live cooldown timers remain local.
- Unsupported codes and codes for the wrong job are rejected without changing your settings.
- Default asks before restoring every job's default ability list and one-row layout, plus the selected side's layout. The other side and active cooldown timers are preserved.

Food Check
- Added party Well Fed status checks with warning thresholds, optional plate tint, and out-of-combat overworld support.
- Adjust the marker's size and X/Y position, plus tint strength, height, and vertical position. The preview follows the settings.

Death information
- Captured enemy damage-downs active at a death now appear separately from the player's own mitigations, even when absent from the killing-hit snapshot.
- Hover the bordered enemy mitigation icon to identify its source when available.
